subject.title: [Bug]: Session write-lock held beyond run lifetime when agent run fails during tool execution

question: Which open session-lock fix should own the alive same-process retained-lock failure reported here?
rationale: The source-level bug is credible, but the available PRs choose different lock recovery contracts and only maintainers can decide the safe session-state behavior before closure.

options.title: Use corrected alive-holder cleanup path
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870 or a consolidated equivalent only after it actually releases or safely reclaims the retained same-process lock and proves same-session recovery.

options.title: Consolidate with maxHold reclaim policy
options.body: Fold this report into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87483 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89673 if maintainers want contender-side maxHold reclaim to be the canonical contract.

options.title: Retarget dead-PID work separately
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100878 as dead-PID hardening only and do not let it close this alive=true issue unless new proof shows the report is actually a dead-holder case.

recommendation.title: Use corrected alive-holder cleanup path
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870 or a consolidated equivalent only after it actually releases or safely reclaims the retained same-process lock and proves same-session recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-source and recent session-lock lifecycle routing candidate from blame and PR history.
